items.author: Boris Cherny
items.summary: Anthropic's Boris Cherny says Opus 4.5 was the first model to write 100% of his code a year ago, but shipping PRs hasn't caught up — so Claude Ship launches in beta for Team and Enterprise. It bundles Code Review (finds bugs), PR Steward (fixes failing checks) and Claude Approvals (approves what team policy allows; the last two in beta). He uses it all day and suggests starting with one repo, with Approvals in observe mode until you trust it.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic 的 Boris Cherny 表示,一年前 Opus 4.5 是第一个写出他 100% 代码的模型,但提交 PR 的流程却没跟上——因此 Claude Ship 面向 Team 和 Enterprise 推出测试版。它包含 Code Review(找 bug)、PR Steward(修复失败的检查)和 Claude Approvals(批准团队策略允许的改动,后两者为测试版)。他每天都在用,并建议先从一个仓库开始,把 Approvals 设为观察模式,等信任后再放开。

items.author: Claude
items.summary: Claude merges connectors and skills into a single concept: plugins. They connect your tools, teach Claude a new skill, or both. Live on Free, Pro, Max and Ultra, with Team and Enterprise coming soon, and a directory of 10,000+ plugins.
items.summaryZh: Claude 把连接器和技能合并为同一个概念:插件。插件可以连接你的工具、教 Claude 新技能,或两者兼得。已在 Free、Pro、Max 和 Ultra 套餐上线,Team 和 Enterprise 即将支持,目录中已有 1 万多个插件。

items.author: Claude
items.summary: Zero data retention (ZDR) with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) is in public beta for eligible businesses. It looks for misuse across many requests while staying compatible with ZDR, and was developed with over 100 customers. EFS is available on the Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock and Claude on Google Cloud, with Microsoft Foundry coming soon.
items.summaryZh: 零数据留存(ZDR)搭配企业前沿安全防护(EFS)现向符合条件的企业开放公测。它在兼容 ZDR 的同时,跨多个请求检测滥用行为,由 100 多家客户共同参与开发。EFS 已在 Claude Platform、AWS 上的 Claude Platform、Amazon Bedrock 和 Google Cloud 上的 Claude 提供,Microsoft Foundry 即将支持。

items.author: Amjad Masad
items.summary: Replit's new research on scaling laws for agent swarms finds that more agents don't automatically mean better results: in a fixed two-hour window Opus 5.5 went from a 3.7x NumPy speedup with one agent to 18.9x with 32, while GPT-6.2 Astra was the strongest solo agent but scaled negatively beyond 8. Decentralized swarms beat centrally coordinated ones, and individual model intelligence was a poor predictor of collective intelligence. Replit is open-sourcing Optimization-Bench.
items.summaryZh: Replit 关于智能体集群扩展规律的新研究发现,更多智能体并不必然带来更好结果:在固定两小时内,Opus 5.5 的 NumPy 加速比从单智能体的 3.7 倍提升到 32 个智能体的 18.9 倍,而 GPT-6.2 Astra 虽是最强的单智能体,超过 8 个后却出现负扩展。去中心化的集群比集中协调的扩展得更好,单个模型的智能也难以预测集体智能。Replit 同时开源了 Optimization-Bench。

items.author: Amjad Masad
items.summary: After meeting VP JD Vance, Masad argues America could win the frontier AI race and still lose the global AI ecosystem: allies want sovereign AI and are increasingly looking to Chinese open models, while US startups need a competitive model ecosystem at home. He pushed for American leadership in open-weight AI and welcomed Jensen's return to Nvidia as a key champion of it.
items.summaryZh: 在与副总统 JD Vance 会面后,Masad 提出:美国可能赢得前沿 AI 竞赛,却输掉全球 AI 生态。盟友想要主权 AI,并越来越多地转向中国的开源模型,而美国初创公司在国内也需要有竞争力的模型生态。他呼吁美国在开放权重 AI 上保持领先,并欢迎黄仁勋重返 Nvidia,称他是这一方向最重要的支持者之一。

items.author: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch had Fable study all his coding sessions to decide whether Opus or Gemini Neon is best — a 'personal eval'. It picked Neon, and he says Google being so back is widely, and wildly, under-discussed.
items.summaryZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 让 Fable 分析他所有的编程会话,判断 Opus 和 Gemini Neon 哪个最好——相当于一次“个人评测”。结果选了 Neon,他认为谷歌强势回归一事被严重低估、讨论太少。

items.author: Dan Shipper
items.summary: Every CEO Dan Shipper says you need to be 'personal benchmark maxxing', and shares a guide from his colleague Mike Taylor on how to build your own personal benchmark for comparing models.
items.summaryZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 说你需要“把个人基准测试拉满”,并分享了同事 Mike Taylor 撰写的指南,介绍如何建立自己的个人基准来比较模型。

items.author: Thibault Sottiaux
items.summary: Inside OpenAI, dots are quickly becoming the primary way to get things done — they even have dots building the dots system. He also says ChatGPT answers should jump noticeably in quality once the update rolls out, alongside efforts to simplify the app, make it faster and merge chat and work by year-end.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 内部,dots 正迅速成为完成工作的主要方式——甚至已经有 dots 在构建 dots 系统本身。他还表示,更新推送后 ChatGPT 的回答质量会有明显跃升,同时年底前还将简化应用、提升速度并合并聊天与工作。

items.author: Peter Yang
items.role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people
items.summary: Peter Yang says ChatGPT Dots still feels very buggy: it sends emails without letting him review them and randomly stops responding. He wants to like the product but wonders whether he's just prompting it wrong.
items.summaryZh: Peter Yang 表示 ChatGPT Dots 仍然很多 bug:会在他审阅之前就发出邮件,还会随机停止响应。他很想喜欢这个产品,但也怀疑是不是自己的提示方式有问题。

items.author: Aaron Levie
items.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues agents break the headcount ceiling on services businesses: output decouples from hours, so one engineer can match dozens and one designer can build an entire design system. Experts are still needed up front to ensure agents deliver the right outcomes. He expects this in cybersecurity, marketing, legal, accounting and IT transformation, and calls it a great time to start or transform such a business.
items.summaryZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为智能体打破了服务型企业受限于人力规模的天花板:产出不再与工时挂钩,一名工程师可抵过去几十人,一名设计师能搭起整套设计系统。但前端仍需要专家确保智能体交付正确结果。他预计网络安全、营销、法律、会计和 IT 转型等行业都会如此,现在是创办或改造这类业务的好时机。

items.author: Madhu Guru
items.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana
items.summary: Meta's Madhu Guru says the word 'data' massively undersells what it is: outsiders treat it like coal to be shoveled into a model, but great data encodes high-value knowledge, taste and expertise in structures that didn't exist before. It remains one of the fundamental building blocks of increasingly capable intelligence, and will stay central to the industry.
items.summaryZh: Meta 的 Madhu Guru 认为“数据”这个词严重低估了它的真正价值:外行把它当作可以铲进模型的煤炭,但优秀的数据编码了高价值的知识、品味与专业能力,且其结构是以前不存在的。它仍是打造更强智能的基础要素之一,并将继续是这个行业的核心。

items.author: Aditya Agarwal
items.role: General Partner @SPC, Co-Founder @Bevel_Health | Ex: Early Eng @facebook, CTO @Dropbox
items.summary: SPC's Aditya Agarwal says most good organizations that survive an existential crisis come back meaner and out for blood, having seen what failure looks like — something he felt repeatedly at Meta. His read on the Nvidia situation: it isn't going to hold back now.
items.summaryZh: SPC 的 Aditya Agarwal 说,大多数优秀组织在经历险些致命的危机后会变得更强硬、更有斗志,因为见识过失败的样子——他在 Meta 反复感受过这一点。他对 Nvidia 的判断是:它现在不会再有所保留。

items.author: Garry Tan
items.summary: YC's Garry Tan offers a trick for startups to self-prompt in a loop: keep asking yourself 'are we dying?' Asking may let you spot the thing killing you and avert it.
items.summaryZh: YC 的 Garry Tan 分享了创业公司自我循环提示的小技巧:不断问自己“我们是不是快死了?”这样问或许能发现正在扼杀你的问题并及时避免。
